Simple Status Legend

BacklogIdea pa lang. Hindi pa sinisimulan.
ResearchInaalam/ve-verify pa ang market, terminology, rules, at functions.
Blueprint ReadyComplete na ang product specification. Ready nang i-build.
BuildingGinagawa na mismo ang spreadsheet/product.
ReviewTinitingnan mo ang design, UX, scope, at output bago final testing.
QATinetest ang formulas, edge cases, bugs, at domain logic.
Ready to PublishTapos na ang product; listing/upload package na lang.
PublishedLive na at puwede nang bilhin.
PausedPansamantalang hininto pero babalikan.
DroppedHindi na itutuloy.
How to use: Open any product and tap Copy FULL Blueprint. Paste it into a fresh Brimly project/session and Astra can build directly from the embedded specification instead of researching the product from zero. Broad research is NOT required. Only do targeted verification when the blueprint is explicitly marked Needs Domain / Platform / Local / Institution / Safety Validation, or when a current external rule materially affects the calculations.

001 Personal Budget Tracker
Current Build High

Purpose

A complete personal-finance operating system: log transactions, plan budgets, manage accounts/bills/loans/savings, and understand money through dashboards and reports.

Target buyer

Individuals, couples, families, students, freelancers, and anyone who wants a self-managed money system.

Commercial tier

Flagship / Premium

Recommended Astra effort

HIGH for normal build • MAX for architecture/final QA

Research / verification needed: Already being built; final commercial QA still required

Recommended tabs

  • Start Here / Onboarding
  • Dashboard
  • Onboarding
  • Transaction / Log
  • Budget
  • Calendar
  • Accounts
  • Loans
  • Savings
  • Analytics & Reports
  • Categories
  • More / Settings

Core product features

  • Month / year / custom-date switching across dashboard and reports
  • Customizable categories and subcategories
  • Customizable currency / display settings
  • Pie, bar, line, and progress charts that update from the log
  • Savings-goal progress and loan/debt progress
  • Upcoming bills / recurring-payment view
  • Beginner-friendly onboarding and sample/demo data
  • Consistent design system across every tab
  • Beginner-friendly instructions / Start Here
  • Editable categories/settings where relevant

Main inputs / fields

  • Date
  • Account
  • Transaction type
  • Category / subcategory
  • Description
  • Amount
  • Payment method
  • Recurring flag
  • Notes

Formulas / logic to build

  • Income vs expense totals
  • Budget vs actual
  • Running/account balances
  • Category totals
  • Month / quarter / year filtering
  • Savings progress
  • Debt progress
  • Upcoming recurring items
  • Selected-period filter drives every KPI/chart
  • Transaction log is the source of truth
  • Budget remaining = planned budget − actual eligible spending
  • Savings contributions update goal progress

Dashboard / reports

  • Net cash flow
  • Income
  • Expenses
  • Budget left
  • Savings progress
  • Debt remaining
  • Top spending categories
  • Income vs expense
  • Monthly spending trend
  • Upcoming bills
